يتعاييا (form VI)
# يَتَعَايَيَا (yataʕāyayā) /ja.ta.ʕaː.ja.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# يُتَعَايَيَا (yutaʕāyayā) /ju.ta.ʕaː.ja.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
